description: Fetch one product page live and return whether it still exists, its current price and stock. Use it on a url from search_products before quoting a price to the shopper. Only allowlisted retailer and brand-store urls; robots.txt is honoured. status: live, out_of_stock, dead (gone), blocked (retailer refused; hand the shopper the url), not_allowed, unreadable. No key needed.

url.description: Product page url, e.g. the url field of a search_products result.

name: check_product_link
title: Check a product link now
